841: Bilaval · Vaar Sat · Guru Amar Das · Ghar 10
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਆਦਿਤ ਵਾਰਿ; ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
Sunday: the Primal Being, the root of all creation,
is Himself present everywhere; there is no other.
He has woven the whole world into His will, through and through like warp and weft.
What happens in the world is what the Creator Himself does.
The one dyed in His Name ever finds spiritual bliss.
But only a rare one who turns to the Guru understands this. ॥1॥
In my heart I repeat the Name of the Treasure of virtues: this is my rosary.
ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਜਨ ਪਗਿ ਲਗਿ ਧਿਆਵਉ, ਹੋਇ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The Lord is unreachable, beyond the senses, beyond the beyond, the Master of all; falling at the feet of His saints, becoming the servant of their servants, I meditate on Him. ॥1॥ Rahao
Monday: the one who, through the Guru's Word, stays absorbed in remembrance of the True Lord,
ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ; ਕਹੀ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
his spiritual life becomes so high that its worth cannot be told.
ਆਖਿ ਆਖਿ; ਰਹੇ ਸਭਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
All who try by their own effort grow weary of speaking His praises and fixing their attention;
this gift of remembrance comes only to the one to whom the Lord Himself gives it.
The Lord is unreachable and beyond the senses; His true form cannot be described.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਹਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
Only through the Guru's Word can one stay absorbed in the Lord. ॥2॥
Tuesday: the Lord Himself created attachment to Maya,
and Himself, placing it over every head, has set each being to worldly affairs.
Only the one to whom He Himself gives understanding understands this play.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
Through the Guru's Word, the Lord's door and home come into his view.
He fixes his attention and worships the Lord with love,
and through the Word burns away ego and possessiveness. ॥3॥
Wednesday: the Lord Himself gives the excellent intellect;
keeping one in the Guru's refuge, He gives exalted conduct, His praise and reflection on His virtues.
The mind of one dyed in the Name becomes pure.
ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਇ ॥
Ridding himself of the filth of ego, he keeps singing the Lord's praises,
and earns lasting honour at the door of the True Lord.
Those dyed in the Name through the Guru's Word become beautiful in spiritual life. ॥4॥
At the Guru's door one earns the profit of the Name,
but this is a gift, and the Lord, who has the power to give, Himself gives it.
ਜੋ ਦੇਵੈ; ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
Be ever a sacrifice to the Lord who gives it.
By the Guru's grace, rid yourself of self-conceit.
Nanak, say: keep the Lord's Name enshrined in your heart,
and ever praise the Lord who can give everything. ॥5॥
Thursday: the Lord kept even the fifty-two heroes astray in wandering and attachment to Maya;
all the ghosts and spirits too are attached to Maya.
The Lord Himself created them all, made them of many kinds, and cares for them.
O Creator, all beings have Your support alone.
All beings and creatures are in Your refuge.
Only the one whom You Yourself unite with You meets You. ॥6॥
having created it Himself, He alone knows the worth of it all.
The one who turns to the Guru enshrines the Lord's virtues in his mind.
Remembering the true Name and guarding the senses from vice become his daily duty and work.
But fasting, keeping ritual observances, daily worship of gods:
ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ; ਸਭੁ ਭਾਉ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੭॥
without understanding of spiritual life, all this effort only breeds love of Maya. ॥7॥
Saturday: forsaking remembrance and dwelling on omens and the astrological shastras,
the world wanders in ego and possessiveness.
The self-willed, blind to spiritual life, stays caught in love of Maya.
Bound at Death's door, he keeps suffering the blows of vice.
That person alone ever enjoys spiritual bliss by the Guru's grace,
who makes remembrance of the true Name his daily duty and keeps his attention on the True One. ॥8॥
Those who come to the True Guru's refuge are greatly fortunate.
Killing ego, their attention becomes fixed on the eternal Lord.
O Lord, they stay dyed in Your love, in spiritual poise;
842: You, the Giver of all comforts, Yourself unite them with Your feet.
There is no other like the One Lord.
The one who turns to the Guru understands this and gains insight into spiritual life. ॥9॥
As the fifteen lunar days and the seven weekdays,
the months and seasons come round again and again,
and night and day keep turning, so is this world: beings keep being born and dying.
The Creator Himself made this cycle of coming and going.
Only the True Lord is immovable, sustaining all creation with His power.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋ; ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧੦॥੧॥
Nanak, only a rare one who turns to the Guru understands this, keeping the Word in his mind. ॥10॥1॥
The Primal Being, the root of all, Himself creates the world,
and according to their deeds He has joined beings to attachment to Maya.
Forgetting the Lord, they cling to love of another and to the visible world.
Such unfortunate ones keep coming and going, and bring spiritual death on themselves.
If one meets the True Guru, he gains understanding of spiritual life;
his attachment to the world ends, and he stays absorbed in the True Lord. ॥1॥
The one on whose forehead such a destiny is written by the Lord according to his deeds,
ਤਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
in his mind the One God alone dwells. ॥1॥ Rahao
Having created the world, the Lord Himself cares for each one.
O Lord, no one can erase by his own effort the destiny You write.
ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ; ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ ॥
If, in his ego, anyone calls himself or has himself called a siddha or a seeker,
he goes astray in wandering, and keeps coming and going.
The one who comes to the True Guru's refuge understands the true path of life.
When one kills his ego, then the Lord's door comes into view. ॥2॥
All this world, which seems apart from the Lord, has come from the One Lord.
The One Lord alone is present everywhere; there is no other.
If, rising above attachment to this seemingly separate world, one forms a deep bond with the One Lord,
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੈ ॥
then through the Guru's Word he reaches the Lord's door with the passport, unhindered.
If one meets the True Guru, he attains union with the One Lord,
and holds back within himself the attachment to the world of duality. ॥3॥
The one whose protector is the mightiest Master of all,
ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਮਾਰਿ; ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
no enemy like lust can overpower him,
because the servant stays in his Master's refuge,
and the Master Himself forgives him and gives him honour.
There is none greater than the Lord.
ਕਉਣੁ ਡਰੈ; ਡਰੁ ਕਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥
So the servant fears no one, and no enemy's fear or pressure touches him. ॥4॥
Following the Guru's teaching, peace arises in the heart,
ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨੑਿ; ਫਿਰਿ ਲਗੈ ਨ. ਪੀਰ ॥
and forming a deep bond with the Guru's Word, no suffering can touch him again.
ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ; ਨਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
He does not fall into the cycle of birth and death, nor suffer its pain.
Those dyed in the Lord's Name stay in spiritual poise.
Nanak, the one who turns to the Guru sees the Lord ever present with him,
and says: my God is ever present everywhere. ॥5॥
Some He has made His servants, and some He has led astray in wandering.
Pervading all, the Lord Himself does everything and Himself has it done.
The One Lord alone is present everywhere; there is no other.
ਮਨਿ ਰੋਸੁ ਕੀਜੈ; ਜੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
One could feel resentment in the mind only if there were someone other than He.
Staying in the True Guru's refuge is the most excellent duty.
Those who do so are honoured at the True Lord's door and counted wise. ॥6॥
All lunar days and weekdays are beautiful only if one stays joined to the Guru's Word.
Only by coming to the True Guru's refuge does one attain the fruit of human life.
All these lunar days and weekdays come and go.
The Guru's Word alone is immovable; through it one can stay ever absorbed in the True Lord.
ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰ ਤਾ; ਜਾ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
The days and weekdays are good only when one is dyed in love of the True One.
Without the Name, all beings, weak in spiritual life, keep wandering. ॥7॥
The self-willed bring spiritual death on themselves, and dying so, they depart in a wretched state,
because they never remember the One Lord, and stay caught in love of Maya.
The foolish person, ignorant of spiritual life and blinded by attachment to Maya,
how can he find the far shore without the Guru's Word? He stays drowned in vice.
But it is not in the being's hands: the Lord, who has the power to create, Himself created the beings,
and Himself established the Guru's teaching on true living, setting beings on the Guru's path. ॥8॥
Those who rely on religious dress keep putting on many garbs,
and roam about wandering from shrine to shrine; like unripe pieces in a board game, they keep being struck down by vice.
They find spiritual bliss neither in this world nor the next.
843: The self-willed waste their human birth and stay spiritually dead.
The one who comes to the True Guru's refuge ends his wandering,
ਘਰ ਹੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ; ਸਚੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੯॥
and finds the True Lord's dwelling within his own heart; he need not wander to shrines on auspicious days. ॥9॥
Whatever the perfect Lord Himself does, that happens.
Observing these lunar days and weekdays only breeds attachment to Maya and the sense of mine and yours.
Without the True Guru one stays in pitch-dark blindness to spiritual life.
Only fools, forsaking the Guru's support, go about observing lunar days and weekdays.
Nanak, the one who, in the Guru's refuge, understands gains insight into spiritual life,
and stays ever absorbed in the One Name alone. ॥10॥2॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
The soul-bride who, coming to this world of a few days' stay, keeps herself free of vice,
ਮਟੁਕੀ ਡਾਰਿ ਧਰੀ; ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
who has fixed her attention on the Lord and cast off attachment to the body,
ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹੀ ਗੋਇਲਿ; ਸਹਜਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੀਆ ॥
who lives her life in this world joined in love to the Lord's feet, makes her life beautiful through spiritual poise and the Guru's Word.
ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ. ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ; ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਿਆਰੀਆ ॥
With palms joined she keeps praying to the Guru: meet me, so that, joined to the True Name, I may love Him.
ਧਨ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ; ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
Through devotion, steeped in love of the Beloved and beholding Him, such a soul-bride drives out lust and anger.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਮੁੰਧ ਨਵੇਲ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ; ਦੇਖਿ ਪਿਰੁ. ਸਾਧਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
Nanak, beholding her Husband Lord, that pure and beautiful soul-bride makes His remembrance her heart's support. ॥1॥
O soul-bride, kept free of vice by being joined to the True Lord, stay innocent even in youth.
ਆਉ ਨ ਜਾਉ ਕਹੀ; ਅਪਨੇ ਸਹ ਨਾਲੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Stay with your Husband Lord; do not go wandering anywhere else.
ਨਾਹ ਅਪਨੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਦਾਸੀ; ਮੈ. ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
Fortunate is the handmaid who stays in her Husband's company. O friend, I too love only devotion to the Husband Lord.
ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥੀਐ; ਸਹਜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਏ ॥
The one who, in spiritual poise, sings God's praises shines in His company. Through the Guru's wisdom, diving into the unfathomable Lord, one should sing the praises of Him who is indescribable.
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਾਲ ਰਸੀਆ; ਰਵੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਿਆਰੀਆ ॥
The Lord, Source and Master of all relish, unites with His feet the soul-bride who loves His true Name.
ਗੁਰਿ. ਸਬਦੁ ਦੀਆ, ਦਾਨੁ ਕੀਆ; ਨਾਨਕਾ. ਵੀਚਾਰੀਆ ॥੨॥
Nanak, the fortunate soul-bride to whom the Guru has given the Word of praise, bestowing this gift, becomes the owner of exalted understanding. ॥2॥
ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਮੋਹਿਅੜੀ; ਪਿਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੂਤੀ. ਰਾਮ ॥
That soul-bride comes under the loving sway of the Lord of Maya, and stays joined to her Husband's feet,
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਚਲੋ; ਸਾਚਿ ਸੰਗੂਤੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
whose conduct follows the Guru, who stays absorbed in remembrance of the eternal Lord.
ਧਨ ਸਾਚਿ ਸੰਗੂਤੀ. ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੂਤੀ; ਸੰਗਿ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀਆ ॥
Joining with her companions in the holy congregation, the soul-bride who stays absorbed in the True One is joined to the Husband Lord's feet.
ਇਕ ਭਾਇ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹਮ ਮੇਲੀਆ ॥
Being single-minded in His love, the Name comes to dwell in her, and she trusts that the Guru has united her with the Lord.
ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਚਸਾ ਵਿਸਰੈ; ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੋ ॥
Day or night, not for a moment or an instant does she forget Him; with every breath she remembers the Immaculate Lord.
ਸਬਦਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਾਇ ਦੀਪਕੁ; ਨਾਨਕਾ. ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੋ ॥੩॥
Nanak, say: lighting the lamp of divine light within through the Guru's Word, she destroys every fear. ॥3॥
O friend, the Lord's light is everywhere; He cares for the whole world.
ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
That unseen, infinite Lord is present in every body.
ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ; ਆਪੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਈਐ ॥
O friend, the Lord is unseen, infinite, endless, eternal; only by killing self-conceit can one meet Him.
ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਲੋਭੁ ਜਾਲਹੁ; ਸਬਦਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਈਐ ॥
O friend, burn away ego, possessiveness and greed; this filth can be removed only through the Guru's Word.
ਦਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਕਰੀ ਭਾਣੈ; ਤਾਰਿ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
Live in His will and pray, "O Saviour Lord, carry me across"; so, going to the Guru's door, you will behold the Lord.
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਚਾਖਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੀ; ਨਾਨਕਾ. ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
Nanak, say: the soul-bride who enshrines the Lord's Name in her heart tastes the life-giving nectar of the Name and is sated from craving. ॥4॥1॥
ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਘਣਾ; ਸਾਚਿ ਵਿਗਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
O friend, absorbed in the True Lord my mind blossoms, and there is great yearning in my mind.
ਮੋਹੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਰੇ; ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
The beloved, imperishable Lord has enraptured my mind with His love.
ਅਵਿਗਤੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਥੁ ਨਾਥਹ; ਤਿਸੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ॥
O friend, the Lord is not seen by these eyes, yet He is Master even of the great masters; whatever pleases Him alone comes to pass.
ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦਾਤਾ; ਜੀਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤੂੰ ਜੀਐ ॥
O Lord, You are the ocean of mercy, ever the source of compassion, the Giver of all gifts; You are the life within all beings.
844: ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਪੂਜਾ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਿ ਰਹੇ ॥
O friend, the Lord's Name dwells within my mind; I know no religious discourse, no trance, no worship of gods equal to it.
ਭੇਖੁ ਭਵਨੀ ਹਠੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ; ਨਾਨਕਾ. ਸਚੁ ਗਹਿ ਰਹੇ ॥੧॥
Nanak, say: O friend, I have firmly held the eternal Name in my heart; I count no garb, no pilgrimage, no hatha yoga equal to it. ॥1॥
ਭਿੰਨੜੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਭਲੀ; ਦਿਨਸ ਸੁਹਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
To the soul-bride drenched in the relish of the Name, the nights and days of life all seem beautiful.
ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਸੂਤੜੀਏ; ਪਿਰਮੁ ਜਗਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
O soul-bride, sleeping absorbed in yourself, see: the Lord's love awakens her from attachment to Maya.
ਨਵ ਹਾਣਿ ਨਵ ਧਨ, ਸਬਦਿ ਜਾਗੀ; ਆਪਣੇ ਪਿਰ. ਭਾਣੀਆ ॥
The soul-bride who awakens through the Guru's Word stays fresh and free of vice, and becomes pleasing to her Husband Lord.
ਤਜਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ; ਚਾਕਰੀ ਲੋਕਾਣੀਆ ॥
She loves her Husband Lord, forsaking attachment to perishable things, deceit, the habit of loving Maya, and dependence on people.
ਮੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਹਾਰੁ ਕੰਠੇ; ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਣਿਆ ॥
O friend, I have strung the Lord's Name round my neck like a necklace; praise of the True Lord is my passport that guides my life.
ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਸਾਚੁ ਮਾਗੈ; ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
With palms joined, Nanak keeps begging for the eternal Name and says: O Lord, if it pleases You, cast Your glance of grace on me. ॥2॥
O beautiful-eyed soul-bride, stay alert against the assaults of Maya: the Guru's Word is awakening you.
ਜਿਨਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨਿਅੜੀ; ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
The one who has heard the Guru's Word and come to trust it begins to praise the indescribable Lord.
ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ; ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝਏ ॥
Through praise of the indescribable Lord she reaches the state no desire can touch; but only a rare one who turns to the Guru understands this.
ਓਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਏ. ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ; ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੋਝੀ ਸੂਝਏ ॥
Such a one stays merged in the Guru's Word, sheds self-conceit, and forms a deep bond with the Lord who pervades the three worlds.
ਰਹੈ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਿ ਰਾਤਾ; ਸਾਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
He stays free of attachment to Maya, steeped in the love of the boundless Lord; the True One dwells in his mind, and he cherishes the Lord's virtues in his heart.
ਓਹੁ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਠਾਈ; ਨਾਨਕਾ. ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
Nanak, he keeps enshrined in his heart the Lord who pervades all places. ॥3॥
O soul-bride called into His presence, the Lord who joined you to His feet loves devotion.
ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਰਹਸੀ; ਸੀਝਸਿ ਦੇਹੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
The soul-bride who worships Him following the Guru's teaching has bliss in her mind, and her human body becomes fruitful.
ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਰੀਝੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਝੈ; ਤ੍ਰੈ ਲੋਕ ਨਾਥੁ ਪਛਾਣਏ ॥
Subduing her mind she finds bliss; through the Guru's Word she succeeds in life and forms a bond with the Master of the three worlds.
ਮਨੁ ਡੀਗਿ ਡੋਲਿ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ਕਤ ਹੀ; ਆਪਣਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਜਾਣਏ ॥
Her mind does not waver anywhere else; she keeps a deep bond with her Husband Lord.
ਮੈ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ. ਤੂ ਖਸਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ; ਮੈ ਤਾਣੁ ਤਕੀਆ ਤੇਰਓ ॥
O Lord, You alone are my support; You are my Husband; Yours alone is my strength and my mainstay.

He cast His loving glance on me, dear to my mind, and my utterly evil thinking was destroyed.
ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਭਈ ਨਿਰਮਲ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲੇ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥੩॥
Nanak prays: the imperishable Lord has met me, and my life has become pure. ॥3॥
ਸੂਰਜ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਮਿਲੇ; ਜਲ ਕਾ ਜਲੁ ਹੂਆ. ਰਾਮ ॥
As ice, touched by the sun's rays, becomes water again,
ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਲੀ; ਸੰਪੂਰਨੁ ਥੀਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
so through His praise the soul merges with God's light and becomes one with the perfect Lord.
ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਦੀਸੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੁਣੀਐ; ਏਕੁ ਏਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ॥
Then God alone is seen everywhere, God alone is heard in all, and it seems the One alone is spoken of everywhere.
ਆਤਮ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਕਰਣਹਾਰਾ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨਾ. ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
One sees everywhere only the expanse of the Creator's own self, and recognises no one but God.
ਆਪਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਗਤਾ; ਆਪਿ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
One is convinced that God Himself is the Creator, Himself enjoys all within beings, and Himself inspires every deed.
ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੇਈ ਜਾਣਹਿ; ਜਿਨੑੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ ॥੪॥੨॥
Nanak prays: only those understand this state who have tasted the relish of the Lord's Name. ॥4॥2॥
847: One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਸਖੀ ਆਉ ਸਖੀ, ਵਸਿ ਆਉ ਸਖੀ; ਅਸੀ. ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵਹ ॥
Come, friend, let us sit together; come, friend, let us walk in God's will and sing the song of praise of our Husband Lord.
ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਸਖੀ. ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਸਖੀ; ਮਤੁ ਆਪਣੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਭਾਵਹ ॥
Give up pride, friend, give up pride, friend, so that perhaps we may please our Beloved Husband.
ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਿਕਾਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ; ਸੇਵਿ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੋ ॥
Give up pride, attachment and the vice of love of Maya, and stay in the refuge of the One Immaculate Lord alone.
ਲਗੁ ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ, ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ; ਸਗਲ ਦੁਰਤ, ਬਿਖੰਡਨੋ ॥
Hold to the shelter of the feet of the merciful Beloved, the Destroyer of all sins.
ਹੋਇ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸੀ. ਤਜਿ ਉਦਾਸੀ; ਬਹੁੜਿ ਬਿਧੀ. ਨ ਧਾਵਾ ॥
Be kind to me, friend, so that, becoming the handmaid of His servants, I give up my indifference to His praise and never again wander elsewhere.
ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਤਾਮਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵਾ ॥੧॥
Nanak prays: only when You show mercy can I sing the song of Your praise. ॥1॥
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਮੈ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਟੋਹਨੀ ॥
The life-giving Name of the Beloved is the support of my life, as a stick is the support of the blind,
ਓਹ ਜੋਹੈ ਬਹੁ ਪਰਕਾਰ; ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਮੋਹਨੀ ॥
for that beautiful, enticing Maya keeps eyeing beings in many ways and blinding them with attachment.
ਮੋਹਨੀ ਮਹਾ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰਿ ਚੰਚਲਿ; ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਵ ਦਿਖਾਵਏ ॥
Many-coloured, enticing, fickle Maya shows beings countless charms.
ਹੋਇ ਢੀਠ ਮੀਠੀ ਮਨਹਿ ਲਾਗੈ; ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਣ. ਨ ਆਵਏ ॥
By shameless persistence she becomes sweet to the mind, and under her sway the Name cannot be repeated.
ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਬਨਹਿ ਤੀਰੈ ਬਰਤ ਪੂਜਾ; ਬਾਟ ਘਾਟੈ ਜੋਹਨੀ ॥
In the household, in the forests, on the banks of pilgrim places, among those who fast and worship, on the roads and at the ferries, everywhere she lies in wait.
ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ, ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਹੁ; ਮੈ. ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਟੋਹਨੀ ॥੨॥
Nanak prays: O Lord, be merciful; give me Your Name as my support, as a stick is to the blind. ॥2॥
ਮੋਹਿ ਅਨਾਥ. ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਨਾਥ; ਜਿਉ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਰਖਹੁ ॥
O beloved Master, keep me, the helpless one, safe from Maya as best You know.
ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਾਹਿ; ਰੀਝਾਵਉ ਕਹਿ ਮੁਖਹੁ ॥
I have no cleverness to please You with my words.
ਨਹ ਚਤੁਰਿ ਸੁਘਰਿ ਸੁਜਾਨ ਬੇਤੀ; ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨਿ. ਗੁਨੁ ਨਹੀ ॥
O beloved Master, I am not clever, not well-formed in mind, not wise, not discerning; in me, without virtue, there is no virtue.
ਨਹ ਰੂਪ. ਧੂਪ ਨ ਨੈਣ ਬੰਕੇ; ਜਹ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਹ ਰਖੁ ਤੁਹੀ ॥
I have no beauty, no fragrance of virtue, no lovely eyes; save me from Maya wherever You will.
ਜੈ ਜੈ ਜਇਅੰਪਹਿ, ਸਗਲ ਜਾ ਕਉ; ਕਰੁਣਾਪਤਿ. ਗਤਿ ਕਿਨਿ ਲਖਹੁ ॥
O Lord of compassion, all beings proclaim Your victory; what You are like, no one has understood.
ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਸੇਵ ਸੇਵਕੁ; ਜਿਉ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਮੋਹਿ ਰਖਹੁ ॥੩॥
Nanak prays: O Lord, I am Your servant, grant me Your service; keep me safe from Maya as best You know. ॥3॥
ਮੋਹਿ ਮਛੁਲੀ. ਤੁਮ ਨੀਰ; ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਸਰੈ ॥
O Lord, I am the fish and You are the water; without You how can I live?
ਮੋਹਿ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ. ਤੁਮੑ ਬੂੰਦ; ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਉ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਰੈ ॥
O Lord, I am the rainbird and You are the raindrop; I am at peace when it falls into my mouth.
ਮੁਖਿ ਪਰੈ. ਹਰੈ ਪਿਆਸ ਮੇਰੀ; ਜੀਅ ਹੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤੇ ॥
When it falls into my mouth, it quenches my thirst, O Lord of my soul, my heart and my breath.
ਲਾਡਿਲੇ. ਲਾਡ ਲਡਾਇ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ; ਮਿਲੁ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਹੋਇ ਗਤੇ ॥
O Beloved, You pervade all creation in Your loving play; meet me, so that I may attain the exalted spiritual state.
ਚੀਤਿ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਮਿਟੁ ਅੰਧਾਰੇ; ਜਿਉ ਆਸ ਚਕਵੀ ਦਿਨੁ ਚਰੈ ॥
As the chakvi holds hope that the day is dawning, so I keep remembering union with You in my mind, saying: O darkness of attachment, be gone from me.
ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਲੀ; ਮਛੁਲੀ ਨੀਰੁ. ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ॥੪॥
Nanak prays: O Beloved, unite me with Yourself; I, the fish, cannot forget the water of Your Name. ॥4॥
ਧਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਭਾਗ; ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਪਿਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Blessed, blessed is my destiny: O friend, my Husband Lord has come into the home of my heart.
ਸੋਹੇ ਬੰਕ ਦੁਆਰ; ਸਗਲਾ ਬਨੁ ਹਰਾ ॥
The doors of my body, my senses, have become beautiful, no longer drawn to vice, and the whole meadow of my heart has turned green with spiritual life.
ਹਰ ਹਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖਹ ਗਾਮੀ; ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਰਸੁ ਘਣਾ ॥
The Master, full of spiritual life and Giver of comforts, has come to dwell in me, and bliss, joy and great relish fill me.
ਨਵਲ ਨਵਤਨ ਨਾਹੁ ਬਾਲਾ; ਕਵਨ ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਨ ਭਣਾ ॥
My Husband Lord is ever new and young, His love never weakens; which of His virtues can I tell with my tongue?
ਮੇਰੀ ਸੇਜ ਸੋਹੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਮੋਹੀ; ਸਗਲ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਰਾ ॥
The bed of my heart is adorned; beholding Him I am enraptured, and He has taken away all my fear and suffering.
ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਆਸ ਪੂਰੀ; ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਾ ॥੫॥੧॥੩॥
Nanak prays: I have met the boundless Master, and every hope of mine is fulfilled. ॥5॥1॥3॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਪੀਉ ॥
The Husband Lord is beautiful, the embodiment of peace, merciful, the treasure of all comforts.
848: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭੇਟਿਐ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੁਖੀ ਹੋਤ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Nanak, meeting God, the ocean of peace, this soul is at peace. ॥1॥
ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਜਬ ਹੋਵੈ ਭਾਗੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
O proud soul-bride, God, the ocean of peace, is found when destiny awakens.
ਮਾਨਨਿ. ਮਾਨੁ ਵਞਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ; ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
To meet Him, pride must be cast out; O soul-bride, give up pride and stay joined to the Lord's feet.
ਛੋਡਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਚਾਤੁਰੀ; ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਤਿਆਗੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
Give up cleverness and cunning, and drive out evil thinking.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਪਉ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ; ਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਹਾਗੋ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
Nanak, say: stay in the refuge of the Sovereign Lord, and your Husband will remain over you forever. ॥1॥
ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਜਿ. ਕਤ ਲਾਗੀਐ; ਜਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
Forsaking the God without whose remembrance one brings on spiritual death, why cling to anything else?
ਲਾਜ. ਨ ਆਵੈ, ਅਗਿਆਨ ਮਤੀ; ਦੁਰਜਨ ਬਿਰਮਾਈਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
But the one whose mind is empty of spiritual life feels no shame, and stays absorbed among evil people.
ਪਤਿਤ. ਪਾਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਕਰੇ; ਕਹੁ ਕਤ ਠਹਰਾਈਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
Forsaking God, the Purifier of sinners, tell me, where can one find peace?
ਨਾਨਕ. ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਕੀ; ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
Nanak, keep loving devotion to the merciful Lord; so the state of true spiritual life is attained. ॥2॥
ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੋਪਾਲੁ. ਨ ਉਚਰਹਿ, ਬਲਿ ਗਈਏ; ਦੁਹਚਾਰਣਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
O tongue, burning in slander and envy, busy in the evil deed of slander, you do not utter the Name of the Lord of the world.
ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ. ਨਹ ਸੇਵਹੀ; ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾਕ ਗ੍ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
O soul, you do not serve God, the Lover of devotion, and the crows of lust and the rest keep devouring your body from within.
ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਮੋਹੀ ਦੂਖ. ਨ ਜਾਣਹੀ; ਕੋਟਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਬਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Through wandering you are being robbed of your spiritual wealth; you do not understand the pain of dwelling in millions of births.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ. ਅਵਰੁ ਜਿ ਚਾਹਨਾ; ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਮ ਭਸਮਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
Nanak, say: whatever is loved other than the Lord, by that, like a worm in filth, spiritual life burns to ashes. ॥3॥
ਲਾਇ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਸੰਗੇ; ਹੋਇ ਮਿਲੁ ਬੈਰਾਗਨਿ ਰਾਮ ॥
O friend, keep love for the Lord; detached from the world's things, stay joined to His feet.
ਚੰਦਨ ਚੀਰ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਰਸਾ; ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਤਿਆਗਨਿ ਰਾਮ ॥
Those who stay joined to Him give up the poison of ego that springs from sandalwood, fine clothes, perfumes and tasty foods, bringing spiritual death.
ਈਤ ਊਤ. ਨਹ ਡੋਲੀਐ; ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਜਾਗਨਿ ਰਾਮ ॥
One should not waver here and there for these pleasures; only those stay alert who are absorbed in the Lord's service.
ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਪਣਾ; ਸਾ ਅਟਲ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੧॥੪॥
Nanak, the soul-bride who has attained her God becomes a wife whose Husband is forever. ॥4॥1॥4॥
ਹਰਿ ਖੋਜਹੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਹੋ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
O greatly fortunate ones, joining the Guru's company, keep seeking the Lord.
ਗੁਨ ਗੋਵਿਦ ਸਦ ਗਾਈਅਹਿ; ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Steeped in the Supreme Lord's love, His praises should ever be sung.
ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੇਵੀਐ; ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਫਲ ਮੰਗੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Serve that God always; through His devotion the fruits one asks for are received.
ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ; ਜਪਿ ਅਨਤ ਤਰੰਗੇ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
Nanak, stay in God's refuge, and repeat the Name of the Lord of countless waves. ॥1॥
ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ. ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ; ਜਿਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੀਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Do not forget even for a moment the God who has given everything.
ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮੇਲਾਵੜਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਚੀਨੑਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Union with Him comes only by great fortune; the one who turns to the Guru forms a deep bond with the Husband Lord.
ਬਾਹ ਪਕੜਿ. ਤਮ ਤੇ ਕਾਢਿਆ; ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਲੀਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Taking him by the arm, He pulls him out of the darkness of attachment to Maya and makes him His own.
ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵੈ; ਸੀਤਲੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
Nanak, repeating the Name one attains spiritual life, and his mind and heart stay cool and calm. ॥2॥
ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਹਿ ਸਕਉ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
O God, You know the hearts of all; which of Your virtues can I tell?
ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੈ; ਭਏ ਪਾਰਗਰਾਮੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Remembering the Lord again and again, beings become able to cross the world-ocean.
ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕੇ; ਸਭ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਮੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Singing the praises of the Lord of the universe, all desires are fulfilled.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਉਧਰੇ ਜਪਿ ਹਰੇ; ਸਭਹੂ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
Nanak, repeating the Name of the Lord, Master of all, beings are saved from vice. ॥3॥
ਰਸ ਭਿੰਨਿਅੜੇ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਰਾਮ ਸੰਗੇ; ਸੇ ਲੋਇਣ ਨੀਕੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Beautiful are those eyes which stay drenched in the relish of the Lord's Name.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੇਖਤ ਇਛਾ ਪੁੰਨੀਆ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਜੀ ਕੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Meeting God, the Friend of the soul, and beholding Him, every desire is fulfilled.
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ; ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਸ ਫੀਕੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
The one who has received the life-giving relish of the Lord's Name finds all the pleasures of Maya insipid.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਲੁ ਜਲਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ; ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮੀਕੇ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੨॥੫॥੯॥
Nanak, his soul merges with God's light as water blends with water. ॥4॥2॥5॥9॥
849: One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਹਰਿ ਉਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗਾਵਿਆ; ਕਰਿ ਨਾਦੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਰਾਗੁ ॥
That person has sung the praises of the most exalted Lord, uttering the Guru's Word as Raag Bilaval,
ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨਿਆ; ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
on whose forehead full destiny is written from the start; hearing the Guru's teaching, he has enshrined it in his heart.
ਸਭ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੁ ॥
All day and all night he sings the Lord's praises, for love of the Lord's remembrance is fixed in his heart.
ਸਭੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ; ਮਨੁ ਖਿੜਿਆ ਹਰਿਆ ਬਾਗੁ ॥
His whole body and mind grow green with spiritual life, and his mind blossoms like a garden in leaf.
ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਇਆ; ਗੁਰ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਚਰਾਗੁ ॥
The Guru's gift of spiritual understanding lights a lamp within, and the darkness of ignorance is dispelled.
ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਜੀਵੈ ਦੇਖਿ ਹਰਿ; ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਘੜੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੁ ॥੧॥
O Lord, servant Nanak gains spiritual life by seeing such a person, and longs to behold him even for a moment. ॥1॥
ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਕੀਜੀਐ; ਜਬ ਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Full spiritual bliss can be enjoyed only when the Lord's Name rests in the mouth.
ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੋਹਣੇ; ਜਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
Raag and melody are beautiful through the Guru's Word only when the attention stays in spiritual poise.
ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਛੋਡਿ. ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵੀਐ; ਤਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
Give up the relish of worldly music and worship the Lord; only then is honour received in His court.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ; ਚੂਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
Nanak, say: if, turning to the Guru, one keeps the Lord's remembrance in the mind, the pride lodged in the mind is removed. ॥2॥
ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ; ਸਭਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
O Lord, You Yourself are the Master of all; You created all beings, yet You are beyond their reach.
ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ; ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
In this whole visible world You Yourself alone pervade.
ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈਐ; ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
Pervading all beings, You Yourself sit in trance, and You Yourself sing Your praises.
ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਭਗਤਹੁ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ; ਅੰਤਿ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇਆ ॥
O devotees, meditate on the Lord day and night; He alone saves in the end.
ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Whoever has served Him has found peace, for he stays absorbed in the Lord's Name. ॥1॥
ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ. ਨ ਹੋਵਈ; ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਥਾਇ. ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
In love of Maya there is no spiritual bliss; the self-willed is not accepted in the Lord's eyes,
ਪਾਖੰਡਿ. ਭਗਤਿ, ਨ ਹੋਵਈ; ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ. ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
for with hypocrisy, one thing within and another without, there can be no devotion, and the Supreme Lord cannot be found.
ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ; ਥਾਇ, ਨ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਇ ॥
Without love within, through deeds done by the mind's stubbornness no one is accepted in His court.
ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ. ਆਪੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ; ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
Nanak, say: removing self-conceit from within and turning to the Guru, one should examine one's own spiritual life.
ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹੈ; ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
Then the Supreme Lord, who is Himself everything everywhere, comes to dwell in the mind.
ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਕਟਿਆ; ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
Joining one's attention to the Lord's light, the cycle of birth and death is cut away. ॥1॥
ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਕਰਿਹੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਪਿਆਰਿਹੋ; ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
O beloved friends, fixing your attention on the One Lord, keep enjoying spiritual bliss.
ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਟੀਐ; ਸਚੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
The one who does so has the pain of birth and death cut away, for he stays ever absorbed in the True Lord.
ਸਦਾ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੈ; ਜੇ ਚਲਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
If people live by the True Guru's will, there is ever bliss and joy within them.
ਸਤਸੰਗਤੀ ਬਹਿ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ; ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
Sitting in the holy congregation, one should ever sing the Lord's praises with love.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਣੇ; ਜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
Nanak, say: beautiful in spiritual life are those who, turning to the Guru, stay united in the Lord's remembrance. ॥2॥
ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ; ਸੋ ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਮਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ॥
The Lord who is Himself present in all beings is the Friend of His devotees.
ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ; ਭਗਤਾ ਕੈ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਘਰਿ ॥
Everyone is under the Lord's control, so there is ever bliss in the home of the devotees' hearts.
ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਮੇਲੀ ਸਰਬਤ; ਸਉ ਨਿਸੁਲ ਜਨ. ਟੰਗ ਧਰਿ ॥
The Lord is His devotees' companion and helper everywhere, so His devotees sleep free of worry, one leg crossed over the other.
ਹਰਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਖਸਮੁ; ਸੋ ਭਗਤ ਜਨ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਰਿ ॥
The Lord who is the Master of all, the devotees keep Him enshrined in their hearts.
ਤੁਧੁ ਅਪੜਿ ਕੋਇ. ਨ ਸਕੈ; ਸਭ ਝਖਿ ਝਖਿ ਪਵੈ ਝੜਿ ॥੨॥
O Lord, no one can reach the limit of Your virtues; all the world strives and strives and grows weary. ॥2॥
850: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬਿੰਦਹਿ ਤੇ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣਾ; ਜੇ ਚਲਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
They alone are true Brahmins who form a deep bond with the Supreme Lord and live in the True Guru's will,
ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ; ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
in whose hearts the Lord dwells, and who drive out the disease of ego.
ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹਿ. ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਹਿ; ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Joining their attention to the Lord's light, they keep remembering His virtues and gathering His virtues within.
ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣ; ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬਿੰਦਹਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
But rare in this age are such Brahmins who, with mind attuned, keep a deep bond with the Supreme Lord.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਚਾ; ਸੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
Nanak, those on whom the True Lord casts His glance of grace keep their attention fixed on the Name. ॥1॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ. ਨ ਕੀਤੀਆ; ਸਬਦਿ. ਨ ਲਗੋ ਭਾਉ ॥
The one who has not done the service the Guru teaches, whose love has not formed for the Word,
ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ; ਅਤਿ ਦੀਰਘੁ ਬਹੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
has earned only the long, lingering disease of ego that drives one to countless cravings.
ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ; ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
Doing deeds by the stubbornness of his own mind, he falls again and again into births.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੈ; ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
The life of the one who turns to the Guru is fruitful, but only the one whom the Lord Himself joins to the Guru comes to his refuge.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ; ਤਾ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
Nanak, when the Lord of grace casts His glance, then one receives the wealth of the Name. ॥2॥
ਸਭ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਚਿ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
All virtues lie in remembering the Lord's Name, but the Lord can be remembered only in the Guru's refuge.
ਜਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਮੰਗੀਐ. ਸਾਈ ਪਾਈਐ; ਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
If the mind is kept attuned to the Name, whatever is asked for at His door is received.
ਗੁਹਜ ਗਲ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ. ਕੀਚੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਪਾਸਿ; ਤਾ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
When the heart's secret knot is opened before the True Guru, every kind of comfort is received.
ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਦੇਇ; ਸਭ ਭੁਖ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
The perfect Guru gives the teaching of the Lord's remembrance, and through it all craving is removed.
ਜਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ; ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
But only the one within whom the destiny of praise is written from the start sings the Lord's praises. ॥3॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਖਾਲੀ. ਕੋ ਨਹੀ; ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
No one goes empty-handed from the True Guru's door; he unites all who come there fully with the beloved Lord.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੈ; ਜੇਹਾ ਕੋ ਇਛੇ. ਤੇਹਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Fruitful is the sight of the True Guru; as one's longing is, so is the fruit one receives.
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ; ਸਭ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
The Guru's Word is life-giving nectar; it removes all thirst and hunger for Maya.
ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਹੋਆ; ਸਚੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
Drinking the relish of the Lord's Name, contentment arises, and the True Lord comes to dwell in the mind.
ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਅਮਰਾ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਵਜਾਏ ॥
Meditating on the True One, one attains the imperishable state and plays within the unceasing music of His praise.
ਸਚੋ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਪਸਰਿਆ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
The one who, through the Guru, reaches the state of poise and love sees the True Lord pervading all ten directions.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਿਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ; ਸੇ ਜਨ ਛਪਹਿ ਨ. ਕਿਸੈ ਦੇ ਛਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
Nanak, those within whom the True One dwells cannot be hidden by anyone's hiding. ॥1॥
ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
By doing the Guru's service the Lord is found, but only by the one on whom He casts His glance of grace.
ਮਾਨਸ ਤੇ ਦੇਵਤੇ ਭਏ; ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
Through it, humans become gods, but only the one to whom the Lord gives true devotion.
ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਚੇਇ ॥
Those made pure by the Guru's Word, the Lord has united with Himself, ending their ego.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਹਜੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ; ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਇ ॥੨॥
Nanak, say: the one to whom He gives the virtue of the Name stays united with Him in spiritual poise. ॥2॥
ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਧਾਈ ॥
Within the Guru, the True Guru, is the great virtue of the Name; the Creator Lord Himself has increased it.
ਸੇਵਕ ਸਿਖ ਸਭਿ ਵੇਖਿ ਵੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਨੑਿ; ਓਨੑਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਭਾਈ ॥
All the Sikhs and servants, seeing it again and again, gain spiritual life; it is dear to their hearts.
ਨਿੰਦਕ ਦੁਸਟ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵੇਖਿ. ਨ ਸਕਨਿ; ਓਨੑਾ ਪਰਾਇਆ ਭਲਾ. ਨ ਸੁਖਾਈ ॥
Slanderers and evil people cannot bear to see this greatness; they cannot stand another's good.
ਕਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੀ ਝਖ ਮਾਰੀ; ਜਾ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥
What can anyone's prattle do when the Guru's love is bound with the True Lord?
ਜਿ ਗਲ ਕਰਤੇ ਭਾਵੈ. ਸਾ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ; ਸਭ ਝਖਿ ਝਖਿ ਮਰੈ ਲੋਕਾਈ ॥੪॥
What pleases the Creator grows day by day, while the whole slandering world frets and frets and dies spiritually. ॥4॥
ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਏਹ ਆਸਾ ਦੂਜੇ ਭਾਵ ਕੀ; ਜੋ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
Cursed is the hope born of love of Maya of the one who attaches his mind to attachment to Maya,
ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਲੑਰਿ ਤਿਆਗਿਆ; ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ. ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
for he abandons the bliss of the Lord's Name in exchange for straw, and forgetting the Name, he suffers.
